answer_1.quote: Recently, large language models (LLM) are not only used in traditional natural language processing tasks such as text classification  and summarization , but are also being applied to a wider range of tasks including question answering , chatting , math problem solving , and planning .
answer_1.outputs: The paper generates natural language prompts and model outputs for classification, question answering, and text generation tasks.
